title: Mutton Yakhni Pulao
instructions: Marinate main ingredients for Mutton Yakhni Pulao with traditional royal spice aromatics.
Sear or roast over high heat to seal juices.
Simmer slowly in a rich nut, yogurt, or tomato broth under dum lid.
Finish with kewra water, saffron milk, and fresh ghee.
Serve hot with authentic Mughlai breads or saffron rice.
